title.en: Labyrinth of Kindo'jan Has No Save Points Mid Run
title.es: Laberinto de Kindo'jan no tiene puntos de guardado a mitad de carrera

summary.en: Labyrinth of Kindo'jan Has No Save Points Mid Run...
summary.es: Laberinto de Kindo'yan no tiene puntos de guardado a mitad de carrera...

contentHtml:
The Labyrinth of Kindo'jan does not allow you to save your run between sessions, forcing you to restart every run from the beginning.

Labyrinth of Kindo'jan


Many players were under the impression that Labyrinths would save your progress between sessions, similar to a Megadungeon. When Patch 12.1.5 launched, players were surprised that you cannot save your run. If you log off for an extended period of time, you will be automatically kicked out and be forced to start over. If you're going for a full clear to get any of the achievements, such as Whose Labyrinth? or Fabled Let Me Solo Him: Kindo'jan, you need to complete a full run, which can take 30 minutes (or more if you find bugs).

One of the reasons that players were under the belief that you could save was due to the announcement of Labyrinths in the Patch reveal:
Blizzard
View Original
Venture through them in a single epic session or tackle them piece by piece over time, progressing at your own pace.
This wording also continued into the official Patch Notes. This statement implies that players can do the opposite of a single epic session, aka multiple sessions. This may not have been what Blizzard meant by this statement, or things might have changed in development, but as of right now, there is no saving your run in Labyrinths. You either do it all in one, or finish your run and start again next time.

The system does allow a period of time where players can be logged out before your run ends automatically. This can be useful if you disconnect briefly or need to relog for any reason. When you log back in after a short time, nothing will have changed. However, if you stay logged out for a longer time, the entire instance will reset when you log back in, and you'll find yourself outside the Labyrinth and have to start from scratch.

 


All in all, if you're going for a full clear, make sure to give yourself enough time!

title.es: Muchas más correcciones de laberinto - Parche 12.1.5 Correcciones en Vivo (Hotfixes)

summary.en: Many More Labyrinth Fixes - Patch 12.1.5 Hotfixes...
summary.es: Muchas más correcciones de laberinto - Parche 12.1.5 Correcciones en Vivo (Hotfixes)...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has posted many more labyrinth fixes in today's Patch 12.1.5 hotfixes!
Blizzard
View Original
Here you'll find a list of hotfixes that address various issues related to World of Warcraft: Midnight, Mists of Pandaria Classic, Season of Discovery, Burning Crusade Classic, WoW Classic Era, and Hardcore. Some of the hotfixes below take effect the moment they were implemented, while others may require scheduled realm restarts to go into effect. Please keep in mind that some issues cannot be addressed without a client-side patch update. This list will be updated as additional hotfixes are applied.

Hotfixes

October 16, 2026

Dungeons and Raids
  • Murder Row
    • Added a visual indicating the safe zone of a barrel during Murder in a Row.
      • Developers’ notes: Recently, we addressed an issue where Zaen Bladesorrow’s Murder in a Row could incorrectly assign a player’s safe spot to a barrel they weren’t hiding behind. With the fix, players must stand closer to a barrel to be protected. To better communicate this change, each barrel will now have a visual indicator showing the radius of the safe area players need to hide behind a barrel during Murder in a Row.
  • The Venomous Abyss
    • The Coiled Altar
      • Fixed an issue where the achievement Watch Out Behind You was unable to be completed by raid groups larger than 20 players.
Labyrinth and Delves
  • Fixed an issue with the “Returning the Bounty” scenario in Jan'alai's Refuge that would occasionally prevent the Pit Boss from spawning in the labyrinth.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Valeera’s Stagger to not function when there was a healer present in the delve or labyrinth.
  • Fixed an issue that caused the Scar of Kathra’natir damage over time effect to deal more damage to Valeera than intended.
  • Fixed a rare issue that could cause players to fall through the map in The Speaker's Chamber area of The Labyrinth of Kindo'jan.
  • The Loa-Blessed Wayfarer mount and Loa-Blessed Victory toy are now granted after completing the labyrinth by speaking with Kinduru if they were forgotten to be looted from the Ancestral Bounty chest before leaving.
  • Fixed an issue where some creatures and bosses scaled their health and damage values higher than intended when playing in a group.
  • Fixed an issue where Sha'kuro's Soul Storm could be interrupted before all Unfortunate Souls were defeated, negating the damage window gained from the stun.
  • Fixed an issue where L00T RAID-R Mini could only be used once while inside The Labyrinth of Kindo'jan.

contentHtml:
In a late-night hotfix, prices for Hallow's End decor costing Tricky Treats were sharply nerfed, making them significantly more affordable.

Hallow's End begins this upcoming Monday, and players are getting excited about the new decor - but the cost was a little worrying. Tricky Treat can take a while to collect, and with some decor costing upwards of 200 treats previously, collecting everything, let alone multiple copies, would have run players thousands of pieces of candy.

title.en: Wowhead's Talebound Talent Calculator Now Live
title.es: La calculadora de talentos Talebound de Wowhead ya está disponible

summary.en: Wowhead's Talebound Talent Calculator Now Live...
summary.es: La calculadora de talentos Talebound de Wowhead ya está disponible...

contentHtml:
Patch 12.1.7 brings Talebound, a new rogue-like game mode to World of Warcraft - and while you can't test it yet, you can check out all the new talent trees in our talent calculator!

Talebound Guide Talebound Talent Calculator


Talebound brings a new type of challenge to players, with the only other real attempt at rogue-like content being Torghast in Shadowlands. From the previews of the content, though, the two couldn't be more different, and you'll want to look at all your options to see what class you want to try out first.



Keep in mind, these abilities are taken from Blizzard's blog on Talebound, and are subject to change before launch.

Slayer
The Slayer is a monster hunter, welding both sword and gun.



Abilities:
Slash: a sequence of three attacks that damage enemies directly in front of you, with higher damage and stun on the final blow. In Talebound, lesser enemies flinch when attacked, making for dynamic combat.

Explosive Shot: Fire your shotgun at enemies in front of you. Closer foes take damage from multiple shots. Empower this ability to deal greater damage.

Minefield: Allows you to leap backward and hurl an arc of mines in front of you. These mines inflict damage and slow your enemies.
Inquisitor
The Inquisitor is a ranged wielder of the light.



Purify: A sequence of three attacks that damage enemies in front of you, each strike more powerful than the last.

Condemn: Damages enemies in front of you, inflicting holy damage and reducing their movement speed. Crucially, it is castable while moving.

Denounce: An empowered ability that inflicts more damage the longer you stand and forces enemies to confess.
Witch
The Witch employs natural forces and shape-shifting.



The Witch uses lightning, poison, spiders, moonlight, thorns, and ravens to overwhelm enemies with a darker, spell-driven style.

Brewing Storm: A sequence of three attacks that inflict lightning damage, with the last strike dealing more serious damage.

Bubbling Cauldron: Summons a plague of frogs from your cauldron. Frogs leap to a random enemy and explode, inflicting poisonous damage in a small area.

Feline Communion: Transforms you into a cat for a short time. While in this form, a shower of stars inflicts damage to all nearby enemies, and you may cast Crooked Path to blink forward, escaping through moonlight.

title.es: Blizzard traslada WoW: Forever Stress Test al 21 de octubre

summary.en: Blizzard Moves WoW: Forever Stress Test to October 21...
summary.es: Blizzard traslada WoW: Forever Stress Test al 21 de octubre...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has moved the WoW: Forever Stress Test to October 21st, instead of the previously announced October 19th.

WoW: Forever Stress Test


The WoW: Forever stress test is open to everyone, with no beta key, subscription or invitation needed.
Blizzard
View Original
Please note that we will do the Stress Test on October 21, not two days earlier as previously stated.

Thank you!
